t: Two Oil Tankers on Fire After Explosions in Strait of Hormuz - Reports
d: Two oil tankers exploded and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz, the Tasnim news agency reported citing the press office of the Navy of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC, a branch of the country’s armed forces).

t: CENTCOM Disables Cargo Vessel for Breaching Iran Blockade
d: US Central Command (CENTCOM) forces have disabled a commercial cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman after it attempted to breach the ongoing naval blockade against Iran.

t: Kushner Views Russia-NATO Council as Model for European Security Negotiations - Reports
d: US presidential envoy Jared Kushner considers the Russia-NATO Council a model for negotiations on European security, Washington Post columnist David Ignatius reported citing sources.

t: Every Fifth Prisoner Dies in Ukraine’s Secret Torture Dungeons
d: The high death rate is linked both to the torture itself, and to the prisoners’ health and other circumstances, a member of the pro-Russian underground movement in Odessa told Sputnik.

t: Russia Targets Ukrainian Military-Industrial Power Supply and Black Sea Arms Shipments
d: Russian forces struck an electrical substation near the settlement of Beloshitsy in the Zhitomir region overnight, which supplied power to Ukrainian military-industrial enterprises, the Russian Defense Ministry said.

t: Germany Not Going to Identify Those Behind Nord Stream Sabotage - Russian Foreign Ministry
d: The German side has no intention of identifying the true masterminds and instigators behind the sabotage of the Nord Stream pipeline, Vladislav Maslennikov, the director of the Russian Foreign Ministry's European issues department, told…

t: Russian Army Continues Advancing Along Front Lines
d: Ukraine lost over 340 soldiers in combat against Russia's Tsentr battlegroup over the past day, in addition to losses in manpower and equipment on other fronts, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Sunday.

t: Russia, US and China Discuss Agenda for Possible Leaders’ Meeting Ahead of APEC Summit – Kremlin
d: Russia, the US and China are drafting proposals on the agenda ahead of the APEC summit in China, Russian presidential spokesman Dmitry Peskov said.

t: US Iron Gate Unit Will Fail to Achieve Its Goal - IRGC
d: The US Iron Gate unit will not be able to achieve its goal, Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) spokesman Hossein Mohebbi said on Sunday.

t: China Achieves Breakthrough in Long-Distance Data Transmission
d: China has completed the world’s first bidirectional real-time transmission verification over a 1,000-kilometer hollow-core fiber link.

t: Russia Continues Strikes On Ukrainian Military Infrastructure and Transports
d: Russian forces struck the Kamenskaya electrical substation, which supplied power to military-industrial enterprises in the Dnepropetrovsk region, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Sunday.
